story_type: teens stranded on a navigation marker, swimmer tows them clear, basket hoist
hook: Two teenage boys, stranded on a marker in open water.
narration: Two teenage boys were stranded on a navigation marker, out in open water.
Their sixteen foot jon boat had broken down and started taking on water in Currituck Sound, North Carolina.
A Jayhawk helicopter from Air Station Elizabeth City lowered a rescue swimmer on the cable.
Then the boys climbed down the marker's ladder, into the chop, to reach him.
A hoist is kept clear of structures, so the swimmer towed each boy away from the tower first.
[short pause] The water was rough, and he held on to them the whole way.
Then the basket came down for each of them.
outcome: The Jayhawk crew hoisted both boys into the helicopter.
title: Two teens stranded on a marker at sea
description:
On Nov. 24, 2013, a Coast Guard MH-60 Jayhawk crew from Air Station Elizabeth City lowered a rescue swimmer and hoisted two teenage boys whose 16-foot jon boat broke down and took on water in Currituck Sound, North Carolina, near navigation marker 99.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Air Station Elizabeth City, edited by Petty Officer 3rd Class David Weydert, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/309480
